title: Petition of Tennessee Gas Pipeline Company, LLC to the Department of Public Utilities pursuant to M.G.L. c. 164, §§ 72A, 75B, and 75D, for authorization to enter upon land owned by Nicholas Hryckvich, located at 116 South Beech Plain Road, Sandisfield, Massachusetts, for the purpose of making surveys in support of an application for the construction of natural gas pipelines and appurtenant facilities to be filed with the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.
filings: Hearing Officer forwards copy of petition to property owner Nicholas Hryckvich
Assignment to Hearing Officer, Robert Shea.
